correctness.rationale: Reconstructed bijection H<-> deficiency S⊂[r], 1<=|S|<=r-t, and edge HK=G iff deficiencies disjoint. A vertex of maximal deficiency size r-t has exactly 2^t-1 nonempty complementary subsets as neighbors; smaller deficiencies have strictly more. After deleting at most 2^t-1 vertices, at least one of r>=2^t singleton deficiencies survives; surviving singletons form a connected clique. Any vertex outside their component contains every surviving singleton; all such outside vertices pairwise intersect and hence are isolated. Its entire neighborhood lies in the deletion set, forcing a cut of minimum degree and fixing it uniquely as N(S) for |S|=r-t. Remaining vertices other than S touch surviving singletons, proving exactly two components. Distinct neighborhoods have distinct singleton members; κ=δ=2^t-1 and elementary κ<=λ<=δ proves λ. Independently enumerated every deletion set up to three for r=4,5,6,t=2 (32119 cases) and each anticipated cut at r=7,t=2;8,3;10,3 (197 cases); these bounded checks do not prove general t.
